title: Gravity and Colony
author: Ada Sandoval
blurb: Beatrix Sterling, a memory-smuggler running contraband past orbital customs, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
